period_note: Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported), compared against the prior period-end position. Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January of the same year, as published in the bank's own 'Un-audited Balance Sheet' and 'Un-audited Profit and Loss Account' for the period ended 30 June 2025. SOLO/STANDALONE basis (header reads 'Mercantile Bank PLC.' / 'Mercantile Bank Limited' Balance Sheet and Profit and Loss Account with no 'and its Subsidiaries'/'Consolidated' qualifier; the same source PDF also contains an earlier CONSOLIDATED Balance Sheet and Profit & Loss Account section headed 'Mercantile Bank PLC. and its Subsidiaries', which was correctly identified and NOT used, consistent with this bank's established SOLO reporting_basis). SOURCE PDF WAS A SCANNED IMAGE (0 lines extractable via pdftotext) -- recovered via OCR: rendered to PNG with pdftoppm at 250 DPI, then run through tesseract (--psm 6). Every balance-sheet and P&L subtotal was manually cross-checked against every internal arithmetic identity before being trusted -- balance-sheet identity (Total Assets = sum of 8 asset lines = Total Liabilities + Total Equity), Total Liabilities composition (Borrowings + Subordinated Bond + Perpetual Bond + Deposits + Other Liabilities), the full operating-income chain (Net Interest Income + Investment Income + Commission/Exchange/Brokerage + Other Operating Income = Total Operating Income), the expense/provision/tax/net-profit chain, the appropriation chain (Net Profit + Retained Surplus b/f = Appropriations + Retained Surplus c/f, cross-tied to the Balance Sheet's own Surplus-in-P&L line), Off-Balance-Sheet composition, and EPS (Net Profit / (Paid-up Capital / 10 par value)). This redundant-arithmetic approach caught and corrected specific OCR digit-substitution errors (documented per-period below) before any figure was accepted into this dataset; periods where a figure could not be confidently resolved this way were left as reported without forcing a correction. This period's PDF was already downloaded and pdftotext-extracted in a prior session, which found the embedded text corrupted and left it unused. This session re-rendered the same PDF to images with pdftoppm and ran fresh tesseract OCR (bypassing the source PDF's own embedded text layer entirely); every balance-sheet and P&L subtotal reconciled exactly or within BDT 1-2 (immaterial rounding). Total shareholders' Equity (27,307,734,873) could not be exactly rebuilt from its own component reserve lines (the 'Other reserve' sub-line was ambiguous between a raw OCR reading of 4,549,787,112 and a suspected corrected 1,549,787,112, neither of which closes the gap cleanly), but is independently confirmed correct via the balance-sheet identity Total Assets - Total Liabilities = 465,579,092,416 - 438,271,357,543 = 27,307,734,873 exactly, and via the retained-earnings cross-tie: Dec-24 Surplus-in-P&L (30,116,656) + this period's Retained surplus (597,934,653) = 628,051,309, matching the Jun-25 Balance Sheet's own Surplus-in-P&L (628,051,310) to BDT 1. This filing's own Jan-24-to-Jun-24 comparative column independently reproduced every digit correction made to quarterly/2024_H1.json exactly (interest expense 10,160,080,183; other operating income 1,430,399,806; provision for loans 1,201,484,583; retained surplus 1,108,749,742), further cross-validating that quarter.
